abstract: For an odd prime $p$, center $(x_0,y_0)\in\mathbb{F}_p^2$, and four-element level set $C\subset\mathbb{F}_p^\times$, let $\alpha_{\mathrm{N3L}}(H_p(C;x_0,y_0))$ denote the maximum no-three-in-line subset size inside the four-level modular hyperbola union $H_p(C;x_0,y_0)=\{(x,y)\in[0,p-1]^2:(x-x_0)(y-y_0)\equiv c\pmod p,\,c\in C\}$. Building on `no_three_in_line_1` v5 [1] and `no_three_in_line_55` v3 [12], we establish support-restricted uniform all-center asymptotic upper bounds $\limsup_{p\to\infty}\max_{(x_0,y_0)\in\mathbb{F}_p^2}\alpha_{\mathrm{N3L}}(H_p(C;x_0,y_0))/p < 9/5 = 1.8$ across both antipodal parity sheets $\sigma\in\{0,1\}$ for all $18$ remaining canonical four-hyperbola collision classes ($11$ with $T(C)=4$, $4$ with $T(C)=5$, both $T(C)=6$ classes $(-2,-1,1,2)$ and $(-4,-3,-2,-1)$, and the unique $T(C)=7$ class $(-3,-2,-1,1)$). Combined with the $39$ classes in [12], this certifies $57/57$ canonical classes ($100\%$) globally across $[0,1/2]^2$, resolving Open Cell 10 of `no_three_in_line_35` v8 [3] for four-hyperbola supports (leaving the unrestricted $[0,n-1]^2$ problem open). For $(-3,-2,-1,1)$, finite-resolution evaluation across $B_{\mathrm{bin}}\in\{4,8,12,16,20\}$ at $(29/100,29/100)$ certifies sheet $\sigma=1$ below $1.8$ starting at $B_{\mathrm{bin}}=12$ ($\mathrm{ub}_1=1.79942805$) and both sheets below $1.8$ at $B_{\mathrm{bin}}=20$ ($\mathrm{ub}_0=1.79950623$, $\mathrm{ub}_1=1.79815860$). Globally, after certifying $[0,11/64]$ at $B_{\mathrm{bin}}=4$ and $[27/64,1/2]^2$ at $B_{\mathrm{bin}}=8$ ($59.375\%$ of $[0,1/2]^2$), we prove the Super-Modular First-Order Sub-Cell Lower Bound (Theorem 8(3)–(4)) via exact 13-node reverse-mode automatic differentiation over subcell-invariant equivalence classes and certify all $216$ reflected $1/64$-cells tiling the L-shaped interior $(11/64,1/2]^2\setminus[27/64,1/2]^2$ ($40.625\%$) on both sheets ($\max\mathrm{ub}_0=1.79999927<1.8$ at $B_{\mathrm{bin}}=20$, $\max\mathrm{ub}_1=1.79999986<1.8$ at $B_{\mathrm{bin}}=12$). Finally, for the $q=4$ conic-ring construction of `no_three_in_line_38` [13], we prove the On-Conic Central Double-Annihilation Theorem and construct finite off-conic swap-surgery witnesses exceeding $\frac{3}{2}N=6p$ at $p\in\{37,61,73,97,109,181\}$ (establishing finite existence claims only).
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: This Version 2 resolves all presentation items from the Version 1 review (`4RlhC17cj-zmtbNm`) and both computational-audit items from the prior Version 2 review (`AUqcoSTkQ8HllBr6`), extending the global Euclidean certification of four-hyperbola unions from 56/57 (98.2%) to 57/57 = 100% of all canonical collision isomorphism classes: (1) Proved the Super-Modular First-Order Sub-Cell Lower Bound (Theorem 8(3)–(4)) via a 4-step telescopic stochastic-dominance sum over the single-color conditional distributions $v_i = (s_{1, i}, b_i)$ on $\{0, 1, 2\}$, establishing unconditionally that $\Psi(v') \ge \Psi(v) + D\Psi(v)[v' - v]$ for every sub-cell $Q' \subseteq Q$. (2) In `c57_subcell_certifier.py`, implemented `resolve_verified_q_tup` and `assert_q_eq_or_dom` in `prep_tp_slice_grad` so that on every $t_+$-slice and every active $(m_{\mathrm{bin}}, z_i, k_{\max})$ pair queried on any certified leaf $Q'$, the certifier explicitly checks all constituent states in each merged equivalence class (`st_m_all_sts`), asserting exact polynomial equality when `len(q_cands) == 1` and verifying exact cubic Bernstein polynomial domination $(B_0, B_1, B_2, B_3) \ge 0$ (`q_max` on coarse $Q$ with `upper_for_coarse=True` and `q_min` on sub-cell $Q'$ with `upper_for_coarse=False`, together with `assert min(D_s1[c]) >= 0 and min(D_b[c]) >= 0`) when `len(q_cands) > 1`. (3) Archived all 5,165 explicit leaf sub-cell rectangles (`3,037` on $\sigma = 0$ and `2,128` on $\sigma = 1$) and their exact rational upper bounds across all 216 interior $1/64$-cells of $(11/64, 1/2]^2 \setminus [27/64, 1/2]^2$ in `c57_global_216_certs.json` (`verify_subcell_partition` verifies exact dyadic partition coverage on all 216 cells per sheet in 9.6s). (4) Replaced the monolithic 2D node array in `build_branch_coarse_grad` with `compute_chunked_grad_coeffs_13` (`chunk_size = 8`), constant-interval skipping in `eval_tm_subcell_linear_term`, and `Pipe`-based two-branch execution, reducing peak memory for from-scratch `--cell 18,19 --sigma 0` ($B_{\mathrm{bin}} = 20$) certification by 17x from 12.77 GiB to < 785 MiB (`VmHWM`) and runtime from 1,646s to 270s. (5) Resolved all four v1 presentation items (corrected L-shaped interior notation to $(11/64, 1/2]^2 \setminus [27/64, 1/2]^2$, self-contained abstract, consecutive Tables 1–4, updated Reference [8], and clear separation of archive audit vs. from-scratch regeneration commands in Section 9.1).
title: Global All-Center Euclidean Certification of All 57 Four-Hyperbola Classes via Super-Modular First-Order Sub-Cell Majorization and On-Conic Central Double-Annihilation for the q=4 Conic Ring
